propositions: The voter-errors alarm fires on single transient self-healing errors (review timeout, curl stalls, retryable gaps) that do not require operator intervention, causing alert fatigue.
A sustained voter failure (expired token, LLM outage, Gerrit down) produces markers continuously across multiple consecutive evaluation periods and must be detected within ~15 minutes.

The alarm must distinguish between isolated self-healing transient markers (<=2 breaching periods including boundary straddle) and genuine stuck gates (3+ consecutive breaching periods) to reduce false positives while maintaining sustained-failure detection.

The metric producer emits deduplicated error counts on a ~5-minute cadence not phase-aligned with CloudWatch period boundaries, requiring M-of-N shape (3-of-5) rather than N-of-N consecutive to tolerate phase gaps and prevent late-firing or missed detection.
